name: 116.2 — a hidden ring is one the pointer cannot be over
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 116.2: the two input guards on a hidden radial menu. It raises a ring by right-clicking a nearby object, hides it with s:flowermenu():visible(false), and then asks for one gesture at a time, scoring each from FlowerMenuRemoved and :count(). After a 1..9 key the ring is still open, still hidden, with its petals unchanged and nothing chosen; a click anywhere ends it carrying nil; and on a second hidden ring Esc ends it carrying nil.
